scripts.build:app: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w app
scripts.build:functions: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w firebase/functions
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w app && npm run build -w firebase/functions
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w firebase/functions && npm run typecheck -w app
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w app
scripts.emulators: npm run build:shared && npm --prefix firebase run emulators
scripts.test:integration:exec: node scripts/lib/kill-emulator-ports.mjs && npm run build:shared && npm --prefix firebase run test:integration
scripts.clean:install: npm run clean && npm install && npm run build:shared
